# Install and load necessary packages
```{r, install/load packages}
library(tidyverse) 
library(ggpubr)
library(ggvenn)
library(UpSetR)
library(DESeq2)
library(DEGreport)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
```


# Import DESeq2 object with group information
```{r}
dds_group <- readRDS("rds_files/dds_group.rds")
```

# Principal component analyses and Scree plots
```{r}
# Get normalized counts
rld <- rlog(dds_group, blind = FALSE)

pcaData <- plotPCA(rld, intgroup = c("hour", "condition"), returnData = TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pcaData, "percentVar"))

ggplot(pcaData, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, shape = hour, color = condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  geom_polygon(mapping = aes(fill = condition), alpha = 0.5) +
  #scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = "lightgrey", "1" = "lightblue", "2" = "blue", "4" = "darkblue")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Wounded" = "salmon1", "Control" = "lightskyblue2")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Wounded" = "salmon1", "Control" = "lightskyblue2")) 
#ggsave("../4_Figures/PCA_all_hours.pdf", width=8, height=6)
```

# comparing controls to wounded at each hour
```{r}
results_0h <- results(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "Wounded_0", "Control_0"), alpha = 0.05)
summary(results_0h, alpha = 0.05) # 2 downregulated
results_1h <- results(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "Wounded_1", "Control_1"), alpha = 0.05)
summary(results_1h, alpha = 0.05) # 4 down
results_2h <- results(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "Wounded_2", "Control_2"), alpha = 0.05)
summary(results_2h, alpha = 0.05) # 1 up, 2 down
results_4h <- results(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "Wounded_4", "Control_4"), alpha = 0.05)
summary(results_4h, alpha = 0.05) # 43 up, 65 down

sig_0h <- rownames(results_0h[!is.na(results_0h$padj) & results_0h$padj < 0.05, ])
sig_1h <- rownames(results_1h[!is.na(results_1h$padj) & results_1h$padj < 0.05, ])
sig_2h <- rownames(results_2h[!is.na(results_2h$padj) & results_2h$padj < 0.05, ])
sig_4h <- rownames(results_4h[!is.na(results_4h$padj) & results_4h$padj < 0.05, ])

# Venn diagram
ggvenn(
  list(
    "0h" = sig_0h,
    "1h" = sig_1h,
    "2h" = sig_2h,
    "4h" = sig_4h
  ),
  fill_color = c("#440154FF", "#31688EFF", "#35B779FF", "#FDE724FF"),
  stroke_size = 0.5,
  set_name_size = 6
)

# bar plot for up vs downregulated
count_up_down <- function(res, timepoint) {
  res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    as_tibble()

  res_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(direction = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated")) %>%
    group_by(direction) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
    mutate(time = timepoint)
}

deg_counts <- bind_rows(
  count_up_down(results_0h, "0 h"),
  count_up_down(results_1h, "1 h"),
  count_up_down(results_2h, "2 h"),
  count_up_down(results_4h, "4 h")
)

deg_counts

deg_counts_div <- deg_counts %>%
  mutate(n_signed = ifelse(direction == "Downregulated", -n, n))

ggplot(deg_counts_div, aes(x = time, y = n_signed, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Upregulated" = "firebrick3",
               "Downregulated" = "steelblue")
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Time Post-Wounding",
    y = "Number of Differentially Expressed Genes",
    fill = "Regulation"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)
#ggsave("deg_barplot_timepoints.pdf", width = 6, height = 4)
```


# Extracting Injury response genes only (removing time effects seen in controls)
```{r}
sig_w_1v0 <- rownames(
  results(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "Wounded_1", "Wounded_0"))[!is.na(results(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "Wounded_1", "Wounded_0"))$padj) & results(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "Wounded_1", "Wounded_0"))$padj < 0.05, ]
)
length(sig_w_1v0) #1191

sig_w_2v0 <- rownames(
  results(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "Wounded_2", "Wounded_0"))[!is.na(results(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "Wounded_2", "Wounded_0"))$padj) & results(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "Wounded_2", "Wounded_0"))$padj < 0.05, ]
)
length(sig_w_2v0) #3028

sig_w_4v0 <- rownames(
  results(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "Wounded_4", "Wounded_0"))[!is.na(results(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "Wounded_4", "Wounded_0"))$padj) & results(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "Wounded_4", "Wounded_0"))$padj < 0.05, ]
)
length(sig_w_4v0) #2863

# Get control time effects
res_c_1v0 <- results(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "Control_1", "Control_0"))
res_c_2v0 <- results(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "Control_2", "Control_0"))
res_c_4v0 <- results(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "Control_4", "Control_0"))

# Control temporal changes
sig_c_1v0 <- rownames(res_c_1v0[!is.na(res_c_1v0$padj) & res_c_1v0$padj < 0.05, ]) 
length(sig_c_1v0) #1331
sig_c_2v0 <- rownames(res_c_2v0[!is.na(res_c_2v0$padj) & res_c_2v0$padj < 0.05, ])
length(sig_c_2v0) #3366
sig_c_4v0 <- rownames(res_c_4v0[!is.na(res_c_4v0$padj) & res_c_4v0$padj < 0.05, ])
length(sig_c_4v0) #2710

control_time_genes <- unique(c(
  rownames(res_c_1v0[!is.na(res_c_1v0$padj) & res_c_1v0$padj < 0.05, ]),
  rownames(res_c_2v0[!is.na(res_c_2v0$padj) & res_c_2v0$padj < 0.05, ]),
  rownames(res_c_4v0[!is.na(res_c_4v0$padj) & res_c_4v0$padj < 0.05, ])
))

# Get wounded time effects and filter
res_w_1v0 <- results(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "Wounded_1", "Wounded_0"))
res_w_2v0 <- results(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "Wounded_2", "Wounded_0"))
res_w_4v0 <- results(dds_group, contrast = c("group", "Wounded_4", "Wounded_0"))

sig_w_1v0_injury <- setdiff(
  rownames(res_w_1v0[!is.na(res_w_1v0$padj) & res_w_1v0$padj < 0.05, ]),
  control_time_genes
)
length(sig_w_1v0_injury) #295

sig_w_2v0_injury <- setdiff(
  rownames(res_w_2v0[!is.na(res_w_2v0$padj) & res_w_2v0$padj < 0.05, ]),
  control_time_genes
)

sig_w_4v0_injury <- setdiff(
  rownames(res_w_4v0[!is.na(res_w_4v0$padj) & res_w_4v0$padj < 0.05, ]),
  control_time_genes
)

# Summary
cat("Control time-responsive genes:", length(control_time_genes), "\n\n")
cat("Wounded temporal genes (before/after filtering):\n")
cat("1h:", length(sig_w_1v0), "→", length(sig_w_1v0_injury), "\n")
cat("2h:", length(sig_w_2v0), "→", length(sig_w_2v0_injury), "\n")
cat("4h:", length(sig_w_4v0), "→", length(sig_w_4v0_injury), "\n")
# 1h: 1191 → 295 
# 2h: 3028 → 755 
# 4h: 2863 → 937 

deg_counts <- bind_rows(
  count_up_down(results_0h, "0 h"),
  count_up_down(results_1h, "1 h"),
  count_up_down(results_2h, "2 h"),
  count_up_down(results_4h, "4 h")
)
```





# Upset plots

```{r}
#UpSet plot - all temporal genes
upset(fromList(list(
  "Control_1h" = sig_c_1v0,
  "Control_2h" = sig_c_2v0,
  "Control_4h" = sig_c_4v0,
  "Wounded_1h" = sig_w_1v0,
  "Wounded_2h" = sig_w_2v0,
  "Wounded_4h" = sig_w_4v0
)), nsets=6, order.by = "freq")
```


```{r}
# UpSet plot - just wounded 
upset(fromList(list(
  "1h" = sig_w_1v0_injury,
  "2h" = sig_w_2v0_injury,
  "4h" = sig_w_4v0_injury
)), order.by = "freq")
```


```{r}
# compare time contrasts (i.e. Wounded_0 vs Control_0) to the injury ones (Wounded_1 vs Wounded_0 -- but after control DEGs have already been filtered out)
# this is a sanity check to see how much overlap there is and if you need to report both separately

upset(fromList(list(
  "Wounded_0h vs Control_0h" = sig_0h,
  "Wounded_1h vs Control_1h" = sig_1h,
  "Wounded_2h vs Control_2h" = sig_2h,
  "Wounded_4h vs Control_4h" = sig_4h,
  "Wounded_1h vs Wounded_0h" = sig_w_1v0_injury,
  "Wounded_2h vs Wounded_0h" = sig_w_2v0_injury,
  "Wounded_4h vs Wounded_0h" = sig_w_4v0_injury
)), nsets=7, order.by = "freq")

# 78 genes are unique to Wounded_4 vs Control_4 and not found in any of the injury response gene sets
sig_genes_list <- list(
  "Wounded_0h vs Control_0h" = sig_0h,
  "Wounded_1h vs Control_1h" = sig_1h,
  "Wounded_2h vs Control_2h" = sig_2h,
  "Wounded_4h vs Control_4h" = sig_4h,
  "Wounded_1h vs Wounded_0h" = sig_w_1v0_injury,
  "Wounded_2h vs Wounded_0h" = sig_w_2v0_injury,
  "Wounded_4h vs Wounded_0h" = sig_w_4v0_injury
)

# Create a binary matrix (genes x timepoints)
all_genes <- unique(unlist(sig_genes_list))
upset_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = length(all_genes), ncol = length(sig_genes_list))
rownames(upset_matrix) <- all_genes
colnames(upset_matrix) <- names(sig_genes_list)

for (time in names(sig_genes_list)) {
  upset_matrix[sig_genes_list[[time]], time] <- 1
}

# Make UpSet plot
m <- make_comb_mat(upset_matrix)

comb_counts <- comb_size(m)
comb_perc   <- round(100 * comb_counts / sum(comb_counts), 1)

# Only label intersections with ≥ 5 genes
comb_labels <- ifelse(
  comb_counts >= 5,
  paste0(comb_counts, "\n(", comb_perc, "%)"),
  ""
)

up <- UpSet(
  m,
  comb_order = order(comb_counts, decreasing = TRUE),

  top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
    "Intersection Size" = anno_barplot(
      comb_counts,
      border = FALSE,
      gp = gpar(fill = "black"),
      height = unit(4, "cm"),
      annotation_label = comb_labels,
      annotation_label_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
      annotation_label_offset = unit(2, "mm")
    ),
    annotation_name_side = "left"
  ),

  right_annotation = rowAnnotation(
    "Set Size" = anno_barplot(
      set_size(m),
      border = FALSE,
      gp = gpar(fill = "darkblue"),
      width = unit(4, "cm")
    )
  ),

  column_title = "Injury-Responsive Genes"
)

pdf("UpSet_injury_responsive_genes.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)
draw(up)
dev.off()
```



# Cluster analysis

```{r}
# Get all unique genes from the three time points
all_injury_temporal <- unique(c(sig_w_1v0_injury, sig_w_2v0_injury, sig_w_4v0_injury))
str(all_injury_temporal) #1717

# Get normalized counts
rld <- rlog(dds_group, blind = FALSE)

# Cluster them
clusters <- degPatterns(assay(rld)[all_injury_temporal, ], 
                       metadata = as.data.frame(colData(dds_group)), 
                       time = "hour",
                       col = "condition",
                       minc = 100,       # Adjust based on how many genes you have
                       cutoff = 0.7)

# Check cluster sizes
table(clusters$df$cluster)

# Create custom plot
cluster_data <- clusters$normalized

# Custom plot
p1<-ggplot(cluster_data, aes(x = hour, y = value, color = condition, group = genes)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = condition), fun = mean, geom = "line", size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ cluster, scales = "free_y", labeller = labeller(cluster = function(x) paste("Gene Cluster:", x))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Control" = "steelblue", 
                                "Wounded" = "red3")) +
  labs(x = "Hour", y = "Normalized Expression", 
       color = "Condition") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

#ggsave("degpatterns_recreated_custom.pdf", width = 12, height = 8)
```

```{r}
# Add intersection information to the cluster data
clusters$df$intersection_group <- NA

# Classify each gene by which time points it's in
for (i in 1:nrow(clusters$df)) {
  gene <- clusters$df$genes[i]
  
  in_1h <- gene %in% sig_w_1v0_injury
  in_2h <- gene %in% sig_w_2v0_injury
  in_4h <- gene %in% sig_w_4v0_injury
  
  if (in_1h & in_2h & in_4h) {
    clusters$df$intersection_group[i] <- "All_times"
  } else if (in_1h & in_2h & !in_4h) {
    clusters$df$intersection_group[i] <- "1h_2h"
  } else if (in_1h & !in_2h & in_4h) {
    clusters$df$intersection_group[i] <- "1h_4h"
  } else if (!in_1h & in_2h & in_4h) {
    clusters$df$intersection_group[i] <- "2h_4h"
  } else if (in_1h & !in_2h & !in_4h) {
    clusters$df$intersection_group[i] <- "1h_only"
  } else if (!in_1h & in_2h & !in_4h) {
    clusters$df$intersection_group[i] <- "2h_only"
  } else if (!in_1h & !in_2h & in_4h) {
    clusters$df$intersection_group[i] <- "4h_only"
  }
}

# Summary table: clusters vs intersection groups
table(clusters$df$cluster, clusters$df$intersection_group)

# Save this enriched data
write.csv(clusters$df, "cluster_with_intersection_info.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# Get cluster data
cluster_summary <- clusters$df %>%
  group_by(cluster, intersection_group) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Stacked bar plot
p2<-ggplot(cluster_summary, aes(x = factor(cluster), y = count, fill = intersection_group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "All_times" = "#440154FF",
    "1h_2h" = "#31688EFF",
    "2h_4h" = "#35B779FF",
    "1h_4h" = "#FDE724FF",
    "1h_only" = "#EFC000FF",
    "2h_only" = "#868686FF",
    "4h_only" = "#CD534CFF"
  )) +
  labs(
       x = "Gene Cluster", y = "Number of Genes",
       fill = "Time Point Pattern") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

#ggsave("cluster_by_intersection.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)
```


```{r}
# Combine the two plots
ggarrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2, labels = c("A", "B"), widths = c(1.5,1))
ggsave("cluster_analysis_combined.pdf", width = 16, height = 8)
```
